profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Meta

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ads ML infra team. Working on feature framework, LLM integration.
Ads events infra team. Working on ads attribution, privacy enforcement, ads signal loss.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Facebook App Monetization org. Video ads team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Cloud
positions.description:
Project Omni: bringing BigQuery on multi-cloud. Moved the BigQuery backend query engine over to public multi-cloud based on Kubernetes.

Details: https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/data-analytics/introducing-bigquery-omni

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Ads
positions.description:
DoubleClick Bid Manager - Google's leading demand-side platform - backend serving team
Worked on multiple features on: user identity, privacy, frequency cap, user ads control (Adchoices, Mute This Ad, Why This Ad) for normal and sensitive ad types.

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Project Astoria (Android on Windows), Operating Systems Group

•	Developed location related services in Java for MicrosoftApplicationServices to enabled 3rd party Android applications that utilize GooglePlay location service to on Windows Devices.
•	Designed versioning and updating strategy for MicrosoftApplicationService
•	Created UI tools and stood up lab automations to allow daily Android CTS test runs

positions.title: Software Design Engineer II
positions.description:
Analog Platform (HoloLens), Operating Systems Group
•	First party application development in C++ and C++/CX for HoloLens device.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer II
positions.description:
Internet Explorer, Windows Phone

•	Developed IE platform input and rendering related features such as text input and selection, copy and paste, hit testing, link highlighting in C++ for Internet Explorer
•	Published Windows Web Application game “Chop Chef” on Windows 8 App store. 
Links here: http://apps.microsoft.com/windows/en-us/app/chop-chef/86a0897d-a375-4add-ad38-88925e4a61b1/m/ROW
Technical demo on youtube: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k2HD4r9VGmY
